answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 4938 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Allah stated in Quran in surah AL-Ahqaf verse#15"AND WE HAVE ENJOINED MAN TO BE DUTIFUL AND KIND TO HIS PARENTS."does this imply only on man not woman,I want to know the duties of woman towards her parents. Question: Asslam-u-Alaikum, Allah stated in Quran in surah AL-Ahqaf verse#15"AND WE HAVE ENJOINED MAN TO BE DUTIFUL AND KIND TO HIS PARENTS."does this imply only on man not woman,I want to know the duties of woman towards her parents. Jazakallahu-khairan. Answer ID: 4938 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1049/981=D -1429) The word insan includes both men and women. Like men, the women are also asked to fulfil the rights pertaining parents such serving them financially, physically, obeying them and avoiding to hurt them. Some daughters are negligent of these things and they keep themselves away and put the burden of this responsibility upon their sister in laws (brother?s wives). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
